cohort: 64 pregnant women admitted with cholestasis of pregnancy to a tertiary care hospital.
finding: The study found that cholestasis of pregnancy was associated with a higher risk of severe preeclampsia, gestational diabetes mellitus, meconium-stained liquor, and low Apgar scores at 1 minute in neonates.
mod_finding: Pregnancies induced with prostaglandin E2 and prostaglandin E1 had a higher chance of undergoing lower segment cesarean section.
